Designed to meet a wide range of user needs, the XBOARD MS keyboard offers easy mode switching between Office Mode and Game Mode with dedicated buttons. Each mode optimizes LED colors and performance, ensuring maximum efficiency. Office Mode is activated by pressing the + button on the top, with a blue LED indicating the switch. This mode supports a 1K polling rate and 10K scan rate, minimizing unnecessary power consumption for an efficient and streamlined experience. Game Mode is activated by pressing the X button on the top, with a red LED indicating that the mode is now active. This mode supports up to 8K polling rate and 35K scan rate, delivering an ultra-fast speed environment optimized for gaming. Additionally, the Windows key lock function prevents unnecessary interruptions, enhancing immersion during gameplay.
The 35K scan rate scans up to 35,000 keystrokes per second, minimizing input lag and ensuring precise response during rapid typing or multiple inputs in gaming. This cutting-edge technology makes the XBOARD MS the perfect keyboard for high-performance gamers and users who demand ultra-fast responsiveness.

The Keychron Q4 HE Special Edition keyboard uses Gateron Nebula magnetic switches. These switches use magnets and sensors instead of physical contacts to process actuations, creating a much smoother keypress without bounce or chatter. The adjustable actuation point is determined not by location but by distance travelled. The PCB is hotswap but only compatible with Gateron dual rail magnetic switches.
Adjustable Actuation Point: Customize each key with precision, adjusting actuation points from 0.2 to 3.8 mm with 0.1 mm sensitivity. Set shallow keypresses for instant actions and deeper ones for deliberate engagement, minimizing accidental touches and giving you an edge in both gaming and typing.
Dynamic Rapid Trigger: Activate or deactivate keys based on how far they travel, not predefined points. This means immediate key reactions—press to activate, release to reset—allowing for faster, more precise keystrokes. In rapid gameplay, this translates to executing complex actions in real-time without delay, giving you a serious advantage during fast-paced sequences.
Dynamic Keystrokes: Thanks to Dynamic Keystrokes (DKS), you can now assign up to 4 distinct actions per key based on press depth. A light press moves your character, a deeper press makes them run, and releasing the key enables additional commands. This layered control lets you execute multiple moves with ease, streamlining gameplay while enhancing control and speed, making your reactions quicker and more precise.
Analog Mode: Analog Mode Experience the power of Analog Mode, bringing game controller-like precision to your keyboard. This mode enables variable inputs instead of the usual on/off signals, letting you achieve more fluid and dynamic control. With each keypress, the keyboard detects how far you press, translating it into different speeds and intensities. Enjoy nuanced control and heightened responsiveness in racing games, sports simulations, and more.
Program with QMK & Launcher: The open-source QMK firmware means endless possibilities for key remapping, macros, shortcuts, and more. With the Keychron Launcher web app, you can effortlessly remap keys, adjust actuation points, set the magnetic switches, create personalized macro commands, shortcuts, and key combinations for each key.
All Keychron magnetic keyboards utilize TMR technology for superior precision and performance. Explore Keychron's whole Magnetic / Hall Effect collection!

Kitsune, the mythical creature from Japanese folklore, is a fascinating and enigmatic being that has captured the imaginations of people for centuries. With its ability to shapeshift into a human form and its reputation as a mischievous trickster, the Kitsune has become a popular subject in literature, art, and popular culture.
In Japanese folklore, the Kitsune is often portrayed as a fox with multiple tails, with the most powerful of Kitsune having nine tails. It is said that the more tails a Kitsune has, the older and wiser it is, and the greater its magical abilities. Kitsune are said to be able to take on human form, often appearing as beautiful women, and can manipulate reality to create illusions or control the minds of others.
Despite their reputation as tricksters, Kitsune can also be seen as wise and powerful beings, with some stories depicting them as protectors and messengers of the gods. In many Japanese legends, Kitsune are associated with the god Inari, who is often depicted as a fox. Kitsune are said to serve Inari as messengers, and are often depicted carrying messages or performing tasks on his behalf.
The inspiration behind this set is the legendary nine-tailed fox and the set draws upon inspiration of the dusky and mysterious colors of blue-purple and peach.

For the past several months, we have been working hard at designing and prototyping Wuque stabilizers, aiming to have stabs that can be easily used for any kits.
